name: post price undercuts the cheapest other auction unless the median is lower
why: 55c - 1c = 54c, below the 60c median

name: post price stops at the 7-day median
why: 70c - 1c = 69c is above the 60c median

name: post price without competition is the median
why: nothing else listed

name: post price without a median undercuts
why: no history yet

name: no post price without either
why: nothing to go by: flagged no price

name: post price undercuts up to the 30-day p90 above the median
why: min(1g - 1c, max(50s, 80s)) = 80s: the market traded at 80s lately, so it isn't posted at half the going rate

name: post price undercuts when that is below the cap
why: min(99c, max(50c, 2g)) = 99c: the undercut is the lower

name: post price without competition is still the median
why: nobody else lists it: med7, never the p90

name: post price without competition or a median is the p90
why: the one price known

name: post price on thin data caps at the median
why: 5 hourly closes in 30 days (< 24): the p90 of 20g is an outlier, so the cap is med7 3g: min(9g 99s 99c, 3g) = 3g

name: post price with enough closes caps at the p90
why: 30 hourly closes (>= 24): the cap is max(3g, 20g) = 20g, so the undercut 9g 99s 99c stands

name: a relist into an empty book on thin data has no price
why: the Spaulders: their only listing is the one bought, and a med7 of 150g from 4 closes grounds nothing

name: a relist into an empty book with 30 closes is the level
why: 30 >= 24 hourly closes ground the level: post_price without a competitor is med7, 150g

name: a relist under a listing left is grounded on thin data
why: Linen at 10c and 50c: the 50c listing grounds the undercut, min(49c, med7 55c) = 49c (PP4 cap)

name: a relist with an unknown close count is the post price
why: an unknown count is not thin (as TT23 and PP4)

name: a rising trend stops at +15% in total
a falling trend stops at -15% in total
a trend inside the clamp is unchanged
a window forecast never promises more than the last 30 days traded at
why: 150g x 52.76 = 7,914g is clamped to max(med7 150g, p90 180g) = 180g

name: a forecast inside the 30-day range is unchanged
why: 1s x 1.2 = 1s 20c lies in [90c, 1s 50c]

name: a forecast never falls below the 30-day 10th percentile
why: 1s x 0.5 = 50c is raised to p10 80c

name: without the percentiles the forecast is not clamped
why: nothing to clamp to: 150g x 52.76 = 7,914g

name: a forecast on thin data earns no premium over the level
why: 20 closes < 24: the ceiling is the level, 6s

name: a forecast on enough closes is clamped to the 30-day p90
why: 30 closes: 6s x 235 = 14g 10s, max(med7, p90) = 14g 10s

name: without a close count the TT22 clamp applies
why: count unknown: the ceiling is max(med7, p90)
